build.board: ClockworkPi PicoCalc + Raspberry Pi Pico H

changes: Command-mode USB/UART shell: shared command catalog/executor, M8/CP1251, history/line editing, FAT paths, slots, fsget/fsput with POSIX CRC and safe upload, legacy raw keys and framed USB Screen.
Linked Markdown viewer: relative Cyrillic paths, visible link selection, scrolling and eight-level back history; source editing preserved.

Native APP services: shared IEEE/EABI runtime, ARMv6-M trampolines, nested text fonts, UI glyphs, revision-checked resources, Explorer, BASIC graphics/frontend, real settings and microsecond timer, ten-item scrolling menu.
Shared cooperative APP flow with direct legacy calls, fresh image data/BSS, resident-owned 64-byte context; FILE_OPEN dispatch independent of the flow hook.
Version-4 settings journal persists text profiles and reads prior formats.
Pico ROM float/double arithmetic replaced with full IEEE compiler helpers after subnormal failures; STM32 numerical kernels and optimizations unchanged.

limits: No batteries available: battery-only clock path, discharge behavior and whole-board current remain unqualified.
Stock Pico H has no independently battery-backed RTC; complete power loss stops time. Sync from the computer or manual setting is required afterwards.
True DORMANT with keyboard wake and continuous RTC needs an additional wake/time source; the stock keyboard BIOS is polled over I2C and provides no separate IRQ to Pico.
M4/hard-float APP require a Cortex-M0+/soft-float rebuild. The loader rejects incompatible CPU images.
C6 physical-storage operations, external STM32 system modules and character-LCD CGRAM are platform-specific and are not advertised on PicoCalc.
